# Brainstorming before building (Superpowers)

Turns a rough idea into an agreed design through focused questions before any code is written.

- Source: https://github.com/obra/superpowers
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obra/superpowers/main/skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md
- Author: Jesse Vincent (obra)
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/brainstorming-before-building-superpowers-84194470

Makes Claude stop and clarify before creative or feature work. It asks one question at a time to learn the goal and constraints, plays its understanding back to you, sizes the work, and writes up a short design you agree on before implementation starts. An optional visual companion can show mockups in the browser while you talk. Part of the Superpowers workflow, where it hands off to the planning skill.

**Try asking:**
- "I want to add team workspaces to my app"
- "Let's think through a referral program before we build it"
- "Help me plan a redesign of the settings page"

**Source:** [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/tree/HEAD/skills/brainstorming) · MIT · by Jesse Vincent (obra)
